name: Jamestown & Lighthouse
alt: Illustration of a white lighthouse beside blue sea
summary: Accra's oldest quarter, with a working lighthouse, colourful fishing boats and street murals.
tips: Go in the morning when the fishermen return
Climb the lighthouse for city views
Ask a local guide before taking photos of people

name: Independence Arch & Black Star Square
alt: Illustration of a large arch with a black star on top
summary: Ghana's national parade ground, topped by the Black Star, built to mark independence in 1957.
tips: Check for public events before you go

name: Kwame Nkrumah Memorial Park
alt: Illustration of a tall statue in a green park
summary: A mausoleum, museum and gardens honouring Ghana's first president.
tips: Allow time for the small museum
Bring water, there is little shade

name: Labadi Beach
alt: Illustration of palm trees on a sandy beach
summary: The city's busiest beach, with live music, horse rides and fresh seafood on weekends.
tips: Go on Sunday for the liveliest atmosphere

name: Makola Market
alt: Illustration of busy market stalls with fabrics
summary: A huge open-air market for fabric, spices, produce and everyday life in Accra.

name: Aburi Botanical Gardens
alt: Illustration of tall trees on green hills
summary: A cool hillside garden about an hour from the city, ideal for a calm day away from traffic.
tips: Pair with the wood carvers' stalls nearby
